claims.explanation: Teniposide is a topoisomerase II poison whose cytotoxicity depends on TOP2A/TOP2B expression and on intact DNA-damage/apoptosis signaling; selective killing therefore tracks with high TOP2A expression and functional p53-dependent or NF-kB/AP-1-dependent apoptotic responses, while resistance arises from drug efflux (MRP3/ABCC3) and from loss of downstream death effectors. The virtual-cell signature (TOP2A downregulation, GADD45A/EGR1/NFKBIA induction) supports a DNA-damage response mechanism rather than a lineage-specific one.
